custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 2 users · 1 browser · about 10 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043). Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher).
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On a QA branch sign in with the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView". The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders). This user is the dispatcher.
  • Location: one location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location. Every technician and work order below belongs to this location.
  • Several users at the test location have chosen non-default settings over time (e.g. Board View, Compact density, Customer turned off in Fields to display).
  • [User-B]: a brand-new user who has never opened Work Orders (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Fresh"), with Work Orders View.

Setup

  1. As Admin, make some non-default choices if none exist: Work Orders > Board View, Density Compact, Customer off in Fields to display.
  2. Settings > Staff > add a brand-new user (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Fresh"; use a new name on each run) with a role that has Work Orders View, at this location; finish the invite so the user can sign in. Record as [User-B]. Do not open Work Orders as [User-B] before step 1.
  3. Check the setup worked: [User-B] appears in Settings > Staff at this location and can sign in. If [User-B] has already opened Work Orders, add another new user.
custom_steps:
1. Sign in as [User-B] (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST Fresh) and open Work Orders.
  2. Read which display option is active.
  3. Click Board View in the display switcher (tooltip "Board View").
  4. Click Tech View in the display switcher (tooltip "Tech View"), open the density control (the button just right of "Asset on Site") and read the selected value. Close the menu and click Board View again.
  5. Open Fields to display and read which fields are on.
